race.comment: STEALTH OF NIGHT (3) is off a let up since a first up run here over 1100m when just beaten for speed. The gap between runs isn't ideal but she'd put up a good level of ability over this trip last campaign and promised to be a bit better again. Drawn well and if ready to go she'll take beating. STAGE 'N' SCREEN (4) stepped up to this trip and got the job done at Flemington third up in a narrow victory. Had the right run there but should get a similar one on speed here. BUTTERNUT PRINCESS (5) has been good in two runs back, getting home well for a narrow third in a similar race here last time. Her best form in Group company reads well. DAVIDA (1) was very well ridden by Shinn to score last time. Back in trip, is she jumps cleanly again she'll give a sight. ENVIABLE (7) was poor considering her $2.50 SP last time, McDonald sticks from Sydney and she had been good in Group races at three.
